analysis:
Examined the docs/developer/test.md changes. Head shows only lines 1-474, so the date bump at head line 3 is the only visible changed head line. Base 940-1389 covers the replaced text at base 1048-1052. The patch excerpt adds head lines 1048-1059 and 1066-1078, which are not visible as head text. The rest of the base and head excerpts are unchanged test guidance with no security-control change.

Material change described by the patch is to the dev-branch release lane:
- Base 1048-1052: dispatch-only with a ref input; no production environment, signing identity or secret; publication only with DEV_RELEASE_KEY.
- Head (patch): triggered by every push to `dev`; calls release-provider.yml with `environment: dev` and `secrets: inherit`; the signing job reads the five Apple signing secrets, signs with the Developer ID, notarizes and staples.

If accurate, dev pushes now yield Developer-ID-signed, notarized provider and fan-helper artifacts under the official Apple team identity, which the lane did not have before. This bears on T-013/T-034/T-054, A-011/A-017 and TB-010/T-045 (the fan helper runs as root). Official-build qualification, not signature alone, should gate App Attest serving (A-017, T-054). Even so, team-signed dev builds widen who can produce production-identity binaries (anyone with push rights to dev). They could also be confused with official artifacts by operators or by legacy binary-hash registration (A-005/A-011).

The workflow files (.github/workflows/release-dev-branch.yml, release-provider.yml) and scripts/test-release-dev-branch.py are not in this batch. Still unverified:
- branch protection on `dev`;
- environment-scoped approval for the dev environment;
- whether Apple secrets are environment-gated;
- whether dev artifacts can reach release registration or official-build qualification.

Documentation alone does not establish a regression, so no finding is filed. Integration should inspect the workflow diff and whether the threat model's release/qualification entries need updating for dev-lane Developer ID signing.
